name: Cougar South/Main Pits and West Spoil Coal

commitments.text:
5. The Proponent shall, upon commencement of the construction of the West Spoil, prepare an annual 
summary of the results of the Proponent's monitoring of water and air quality and West Spoil stability, 
provided for that year to either the Regional Manager, Energy and Minerals Division, Ministry of 
Employment and Investment, Cranbrook, or the Industrial Environmental Protection Officer, 
Environmental Protection, Ministry of Environment, Lands and Parks, Cranbrook, and the Proponent 
shall make this summary available to the public by placing the summary in the Elkford Public Library.

6. The Proponent must, in the reasonable opinion of the Minister, have substantially started the Project 
within five years of the date of issuance of this Project Approval Certificate.
